reviews.text: I liked the peach one better. the smell isn’t very strong and the strawberry scent is very artificial and gives me a headache. very basic moisturiser so if you want something that will actually rejuvenate your skin I would look elsewhere. good for layering scents on a night out but not actual beauty care I think. would not be good if you are super dry. I am only like a little bit dry and I don’t even think it’s that great on my skin.
reviews.zh: 我覺得桃子味嗰款好啲。味道唔係好濃，士多啤梨味好人工，令我頭痛。基礎保濕霜，如果你想要真正令皮膚年輕嘅，我建議你揀其他產品。用嚟夜晚出去玩時疊香水唔錯，但我覺得唔係真正嘅護膚產品。如果你好乾燥就唔好用。我只係有少少乾，而且我都唔覺得佢對我皮膚咁好。

reviews.text:
I am OBSESSED. Like… genuinely, capital letters, no shame OBSESSED.
This smells absolutely divine—think perky, sweet banana vibes mixed with full-on nostalgic banana milkshake energy. If you grew up on those classic thick shakes (you already know the vibe), this will hit hard in the best way.
But it’s not just the scent—my skin actually feels soft and moisturised after using it, not tight or stripped like some body washes. It’s creamy, lush, and leaves you feeling clean and hydrated, which is a combo we love.
Honestly, it turns a basic shower into a whole experience. If you’re into fun, nostalgic scents and silky-soft skin… you need this.
reviews.zh:
我真係好迷！真係，大寫，冇咩羞恥嘅迷戀。
呢款香味實在太好聞——甜甜、似香蕉嘅感覺，加埋滿滿懷舊香蕉奶昔嘅感覺。如果你成長期間飲過經典濃厚奶昔（你已經知道咁嘅感覺），呢款一定會好打動你。
但係唔單止係香味——用完我嘅皮膚真係感覺柔軟、潤滑，唔似某啲沐浴露咁緊繃或被扯乾。佢質地豐潤、輕盈，令你感覺清潔同水潤，呢個組合我哋好愛。
老實講，佢令普通嘅沖涼變成一個完整嘅體驗。如果你鍾意有趣、懷舊嘅香味，又想要絲滑柔軟嘅皮膚……你一定要試吓呢款。

reviews.text: i love the sweet strawberry milk scent. it reminds me of nesquik but a bit more fresh. i pair it with the same series strawberry milk body lotion. using this makes me feel like strawberry shortcake and i love it!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意士多啤梨奶嘅香味。令我諗起 Nesquik，但係比較清新啲。我配咗同系列嘅士多啤梨奶身體乳。用緊呢款令我覺得自己似草莓蛋糕（strawberry shortcake），我好鍾意！

reviews.text:
This body cleanser smells so good like fresh, sweet strawberries, not too strong or artificial. It lathers up nicely, feels super gentle on the skin, and leaves me feeling really clean without any dryness. After using it, my skin feels soft and there’s a light fruity scent that lingers, which I personally love!

If you enjoy fruity, refreshing body care products, this one is definitely worth trying. Plus, the packaging is really cute and looks adorable in the shower.
reviews.zh:
呢款身體潔面產品好香，好似新鮮甜草莓咁，唔會太濃或者人工。起泡好好，對皮膚好温和，用完令我覺得好乾淨，唔會乾燥。用完之後皮膚感覺軟滑，仲有淡淡嘅果香留返，我個人好鍾意！

如果你鍾意果香、清新嘅身體護理產品，呢款絕對值得試。加上，包裝好可愛，喺沖涼房擺放都好靚。

reviews.text: Great body cleanser! It lathers well, leaves skin soft and refreshed, and has a pleasant scent. Doesn’t dry out the skin and works well for daily use. Plus, the packaging is convenient. Highly recommend!
reviews.zh: 好好嘅身體潔面產品！起泡好好，令皮膚柔軟、清爽，香味令人舒服。唔會令皮膚乾燥，日常用都好好。另外，包裝都好方便。極力推薦！

reviews.text: I’m in love with this body wash, at the first i was like ah no it smells like strawberry candies.. like too sweet and i don’t like that but then i was like oh probably it’s going to be less after rising it.. and YESSSS the true strawberry smell left me fresh for hours and with the body lotion from the same brand ! chef kiss.. thank you girlies for sharing this everywhere, i would get it again and again and try different scents.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款沐浴露。一開始我心諗，嗰股味好似士多啤梨糖咁，太甜，我唔鍾意，但係我又諗，可能沖完會淡啲……結果真係！真正嘅士多啤梨香味令我清新咗好幾個鐘，再配埋同一品牌嘅身體乳，完美！多謝大家到處分享，我會再買，仲會試其他香味。

reviews.text: I got this seeing how everyone loves it and the packaging is so adorable. I have dry skin and I found this moisturising and it also foams really well and doesn’t leave any residue behind! I really love the fragrance of this as it smells like sweet strawberry candy 🍓 Such a yourhful smell! The pack is quite big so it will last me a long time~
reviews.zh: 我因為見到大家都鍾意先買，個包裝好可愛。我皮膚乾，我覺得呢款好滋潤，仲起泡好好，而且唔會留低任何殘留！我好鍾意呢款香味，聞落好似甜甜嘅士多啤梨糖 🍓 好青春嘅味道！個裝幾大，會用好耐~

reviews.text: This body cleanser smells so yummy and my whole shower is filled with the scent. I look forward to taking a shower with this. It comes out creamy but foams up quickly. It isn't too drying on the skin and feels nice.
reviews.zh: 呢款身體潔面產品好香，我成個沖涼房都充滿咗佢嘅味道。我好期待每次沖涼用佢。出嚟係奶狀，但係好快就起泡。用完唔會好乾，感覺都好舒服。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
